value.rationale: A complete sharp stability-density crossover for a physically natural pair of near-equal rotating control modes measures a substantial loss of usable common sampling periods, with unique beat-scale minimum below both resonant and incommensurate baselines. This is structurally motivated by simultaneous multi-mode sampling constraints, analytically nontrivial averaging, and a falsifiable benchmark rather than a routine isolated table.
